transforms.operation: Resolve the friendly force-disposition id to its repository disposition slug.

filters: Use the English localized display name.
precedence: The dump disposition is authoritative; a matched record's field is corrected to it.
/disposition.reason: runMissionMatchups derives the friendly disposition slug from force_disposition_mission and writes it onto the matchup record (fill on seed, correct on drift, confirm otherwise).

/game_version.reason: The matchup release/version label is repository-authored; dump snapshot metadata is not an entity game-version source.

/game_version/dataslate.reason: The dataslate label is repository-authored and is not inferred from dump snapshot metadata.

/game_version/edition.reason: The edition label is repository-authored and is not inferred from dump snapshot metadata.

transforms.operation: Resolve each ordered disposition id to its slug and join the friendly and opposition slugs with '-vs-'.

filters: Use English localized display names for both sides.
precedence: Preserve the ordered friendly-versus-opposition slug pair; do not replace it with the dump row id.
/id.reason: runMissionMatchups derives the deterministic '<disposition>-vs-<opponent>' key from the two disposition relations and keys the matchup record by it (seeding any dump pairing the repo lacks).

transforms.operation: Normalize the linked primary-mission English display name to the repository mission id.

filters: Use the English localized display name.
Retain only primary missions represented by the repository mission inventory.
precedence: The dump primary-mission identity is authoritative; a matched record's mission_id is corrected to it.
/mission_id.reason: runMissionMatchups resolves the linked primary mission to its repository id and writes it onto the matchup record.

transforms.operation: Resolve the opposition force-disposition id to its repository disposition slug.

filters: Use the English localized display name.
precedence: The dump disposition is authoritative; a matched record's field is corrected to it.
/opponent_disposition.reason: runMissionMatchups derives the opposition disposition slug from force_disposition_mission and writes it onto the matchup record.

unmapped_mfm_fields.reason: Join key from a disposition matchup (25) to its recommended presets; recommendations do not change legality.
Join key to one of 45 recommended presets; recommendations do not change legality.
Join key from a mission preset to one of 48 MFM layouts; presets are app recommendations with no repository entity.
Join key from a mission preset to one of 9 deployments; presets are app recommendations with no repository entity.
Join key, one per MFM mission layout (48); it names an MFM layout, not a repository terrain layout.
Join key naming which of the 9 deployments a layout pairs with; repository layouts are authored from Battlemaster, not this table.
